reason: Tata Motors' indirect subsidiary has launched a voluntary tender offer for all common shares of Iveco Group, creating a floor for the stock price near the offer level.
why_now: The tender offer was formally announced by Tata Motors on September 1, 2026.
source_headlines: Tata Motors Limited: Tata Motors Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 01, 2026, titled "TML CV Holdings B.V., an Indirect Wholly Owned Subsidiary of Tata Motors Limited Voluntary Totalitarian Tender Offer for all the common shares of Iveco Group N.V.".
